Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,535 million. The general discount stores sell footwear as well as food, apparel, daily necessities and other goods, while the shoe specialty stores sell footwear. During the fiscal year ended March 2026, it opened five new shoe specialty stores, and as of March 31, 2026, it operated 18 shoe specialty stores in the Keihanshin area.
entries.4168690fd1529a43: The company recognizes that expansion of the shoe and footwear market, its core business, cannot be expected.
